records.jp: ここは……？
records.en_original: Where...am I?
records.en: Where...am I?

records.en_original: Ngh, ugh...
records.en: Ngh, ugh...

records.jp: 森崎さんっ！！<CR>目を醒ましたんですかっ！？
records.en_original: Alesia! Did you wake up?!
records.en: Alesia! Did you wake up?!

records.jp: 詩帆、ごめんなさい。<CR>貴方まで天国に、来てしまったのね……
records.en_original: Shiho, I'm sorry. Looks like you've ended up in heaven too...
records.en: Shiho, I'm sorry. Looks like you've ended up in heaven too...

records.jp: 何を寝ぼけたことを言ってるんですか！！<CR>森崎さんは、まだ生きてるんですよ！？
records.en_original: What are you talking about?! You're still alive!
records.en: What are you talking about?! You're still alive!

records.jp: ……そうなの？
records.en_original: ...Is that true?
records.en: ...Is that true?

records.jp: そうでなかったら困ります！<CR>わたし、夜通しで何十回も回復……をっ……ぐすっ……
records.en_original: It better be, or I'm in trouble! I spent all night healing you, over and over... *Sniff*
records.en: It better be, or I'm in trouble! I spent all night healing you, over and over... *Sniff*

records.jp: よかった……森崎さん……、元気に……っ……
records.en_original: Thank goodness... Alesia, you're okay!
records.en: Thank goodness... Alesia, you're okay!

records.jp: ……ありがとう……神様
records.en_original: Thank you... God.
records.en: Thank you... God.

records.jp: でも、ビックリしました。気がついたら、<CR>わたし助かってて、代わりに森崎さんが倒れてて
records.en_original: I was really surprised when I came to. I was totally fine, and you had collapsed instead, Alesia.
records.en: I was really surprised when I came to. I was totally fine, and you had collapsed instead, Alesia.

records.jp: リーダーさんから、森崎さんの能力で、<CR>エーテルを入れ替えたんだって聞きました
records.en_original: Leader told me that you switched our Ether using your ability.
records.en: Leader told me that you switched our Ether using your ability.

records.jp: どうして、そんな危険なことを……
records.en_original: Why would you do something so dangerous?
records.en: Why would you do something so dangerous?

records.jp: 人は簡単に死ぬ。私だってそう。<CR>だから、私が死ぬのは怖くない
records.en_original: People die easily. The same goes for me. I'm not afraid of dying.
records.en: People die easily. The same goes for me. I'm not afraid of dying.

records.jp: けど、もうこれ以上――
records.en_original: But I just couldn't—
records.en: But I just couldn't—

records.jp: これ以上……友達……が、<CR>死んでいくのを見るのは耐えられなかったから
records.en_original: I just couldn't bear to watch any more of my friends die.
records.en: I just couldn't bear to watch any more of my friends die.

records.jp: 森崎さん……
records.en_original: Alesia...
records.en: Alesia...

records.jp: 私はルーマニアで生まれ育った。<CR>パパもママもとても優しかった
records.en_original: I was born and raised in Romania. My dad and mom were really kind.
records.en: I was born and raised in Romania. My dad and mom were really kind.

records.jp: 友達もたくさんいた。けど……<CR>みんな、いなくなってしまった。私だけを残して
records.en_original: I had lots of friends too. But...in the end, everyone disappeared. I was the only one left.
records.en: I had lots of friends too. But...in the end, everyone disappeared. I was the only one left.

records.jp: 私には死神が憑いているんだって思った。<CR>それで……、もう誰とも近づかないって神様に誓ったの
records.en_original: It started to feel like I had the grim reaper following me. That's why...I swore to God I'd never get close to anyone again.
records.en: It started to feel like I had the grim reaper following me. That's why...I swore to God I'd never get close to anyone again.

records.jp: けど、日本に来てすぐに、その誓いを破ってしまった。<CR>亜美のことを好きになってしまったから
records.en_original: But right after I came to Japan, I broke that vow. Because I became close with Ami.
records.en: But right after I came to Japan, I broke that vow. Because I became close with Ami.

records.jp: 私の近くにいれば、あなたも、いつか――
records.en_original: If you get close to me, you too might someday—
records.en: If you get close to me, you too might someday—

records.jp: わたしは死にません
records.en_original: I won't die.
records.en: I won't die.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: 森崎さんに言わせれば、<CR>“不平等”なのかもしれないけど……
records.en_original: It might be unfair to you, Alesia...
records.en: It might be unfair to you, Alesia...

records.jp: それでも言わせてください。<CR>わたしは死なない。森崎さんも死なせない
records.en_original: But let me say it anyway. I won't die. And I won't let you die, either.
records.en: But let me say it anyway. I won't die. And I won't let you die, either.

records.jp: な、なぜそんな――
records.en_original: W-why would you—
records.en: W-why would you—

records.jp: わたしの能力、知ってますか？
records.en_original: Do you know what my ability is?
records.en: Do you know what my ability is?

records.jp: 「快癒の力」。人の傷を癒す力です
records.en_original: It's "healing." The power to heal people's wounds.
records.en: It's "healing." The power to heal people's wounds.

records.jp: わたし、考えてたんです。<CR>なぜわたしに宿ったのが「快癒の力」だったのか
records.en_original: I've been thinking about it. Why did I gain the power to heal?
records.en: I've been thinking about it. Why did I gain the power to heal?

records.jp: きっと……森崎さんや、みんな。わたしにとっての<CR>大切な人たちを、癒すためだったんです
records.en_original: I'm sure it's so that I can heal people who are important to me, like you, and everyone else.
records.en: I'm sure it's so that I can heal people who are important to me, like you, and everyone else.

records.jp: 大切……
records.en_original: Important...
records.en: Important...

records.jp: 森崎さんも同じでしょう？
records.en_original: Isn't it the same for you, Alesia?
records.en: Isn't it the same for you, Alesia?

records.jp: 大切な人を失うのが辛い。<CR>他人を想えるからこそ……強く傷ついてしまう
records.en_original: Losing someone important to you is so painful. It's because we care about others that we end up truly hurt.
records.en: Losing someone important to you is so painful. It's because we care about others that we end up truly hurt.

records.jp: あなたは死神なんかじゃない。<CR>大切な人を想える、優しい人です
records.en_original: You're not the grim reaper. You're a kind person who can care for those dear to you.
records.en: You're not the grim reaper. You're a kind person who can care for those dear to you.

records.jp: きっと、そんなあなただからこそ、<CR>その力が宿ったんです
records.en_original: I'm sure that's exactly why such a power awakened within you.
records.en: I'm sure that's exactly why such a power awakened within you.

records.jp: ――“エーテル・スワップ”。<CR>人の痛みを、理解する力
records.en_original: Your power—"Ether Swap." The ability to understand the pain of others.
records.en: Your power—"Ether Swap." The ability to understand the pain of others.

records.jp: ……森崎さん。わたしには、<CR>あなたの傷を癒すことはできませんか？
records.en_original: ...Alesia. I wonder if I can heal your wounds for you.
records.en: ...Alesia. I wonder if I can heal your wounds for you.

records.jp: ……あれだけ酷いことをされたのに、<CR>なんで貴方はそんなに優しくしてくれるの？
records.en_original: After everything I did to you, how can you still be so kind to me?
records.en: After everything I did to you, how can you still be so kind to me?

records.jp: ……灰だらけの世界です。<CR>死が身近になってしまった
records.en_original: This world is covered in Ash now. Death has become far too close.
records.en: This world is covered in Ash now. Death has become far too close.

records.jp: きっとこの先、理不尽なことも、喪失も、<CR>たくさんあると思うんです
records.en_original: I'm sure from here on, there'll be a lot of unfair things, and plenty of loss too.
records.en: I'm sure from here on, there'll be a lot of unfair things, and plenty of loss too.

records.jp: 高岡さんと久野さんが言ってました。<CR>日常を失えば、“戻ってこれなくなる”って
records.en_original: Yukiko and Kirara were saying it. If you lose your everyday life, you can never come back.
records.en: Yukiko and Kirara were saying it. If you lose your everyday life, you can never come back.

records.jp: だからこそ、誰かが一緒にいてあげないと。<CR>だって……友達がいないと、寂しいじゃないですか
records.en_original: That's exactly why someone needs to be there for you. I mean...not having any friends around would be lonely, right?
records.en: That's exactly why someone needs to be there for you. I mean...not having any friends around would be lonely, right?

records.jp: わたし自身、<CR>それをリーダーさんやみんなに教えてもらったから
records.en_original: I learned that myself from Leader and everyone else.
records.en: I learned that myself from Leader and everyone else.

records.jp: ……ありがとう。<CR>こんな、私を……
records.en_original: Thank you. For accepting someone like me.
records.en: Thank you. For accepting someone like me.

records.jp: ……詩帆、この小瓶
records.en_original: Shiho, this little bottle...
records.en: Shiho, this little bottle...

records.jp: それは……わたしがプレゼントした星の砂……
records.en_original: That's the star sand I gave you as a present...
records.en: That's the star sand I gave you as a present...

records.jp: そう。もう中身は灰に変わってしまったけれど
records.en_original: Yeah. The contents have turned to Ash now, though.
records.en: Yeah. The contents have turned to Ash now, though.

records.jp: あの時はごめんなさい。<CR>何も言わず、唐突に中身を捨ててしまって
records.en_original: I'm sorry about that. I threw out the contents without saying a word.
records.en: I'm sorry about that. I threw out the contents without saying a word.

records.jp: 代わりになる、とは言わないけど……
records.en_original: I can't say this can ever take its place, but...
records.en: I can't say this can ever take its place, but...

records.jp: この灰の小瓶は、貴方に持っていてほしい。<CR>そして、詩帆の星の砂を私にもらえたら……嬉しい
records.en_original: I want you to have this bottle filled with Ash. And if you gave me your star sand...I'd be really happy.
records.en: I want you to have this bottle filled with Ash. And if you gave me your star sand...I'd be really happy.

records.jp: 互いが互いを尊重して、<CR>互いの好きなものを大切にしたい
records.en_original: I want us to respect each other, and cherish the things we each love.
records.en: I want us to respect each other, and cherish the things we each love.

records.jp: ……友達、として
records.en_original: As friends.
records.en: As friends.

records.jp: うんっ、もちろんだよ！
records.en_original: Yeah, of course!
records.en: Yeah, of course!

records.jp: ……改めて、よろしく
records.en_original: I'll say it again: let's do our best together.
records.en: I'll say it again: let's do our best together.

records.jp: うん……。こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします！
records.en_original: Yeah... Thank you, I'm counting on you too!
records.en: Yeah... Thank you, I'm counting on you too!

records.jp: よかった。一時はどうなるかと思ったぞ
records.en_original: I'm so glad. For a moment, I was really worried.
records.en: I'm so glad. For a moment, I was really worried.

records.jp: ほんと、奇跡って起こるものなんだね！
records.en_original: You can say that again. Miracles really do happen, don't they!
records.en: You can say that again. Miracles really do happen, don't they!

records.jp: ふふふ～、今夜は快気祝いをしなくちゃね～
records.en_original: Hee hee, We need to celebrate our progress tonight!
records.en: Hee hee, We need to celebrate our progress tonight!

records.jp: リーダーさん、皆さん、本当にありがとうございました
records.en_original: Leader, everyone...thank you so much.
records.en: Leader, everyone...thank you so much.

records.jp: リーダーさんがいなかったら、わたしも森崎さんも<CR>もうこの世にいなかったかもしれないです
records.en_original: If you hadn't been here, both Alesia and I might not even be alive right now.
records.en: If you hadn't been here, both Alesia and I might not even be alive right now.

records.jp: ほんとね。今回もまた、リーダーのお手柄
records.en_original: It's true. Leader saved the day again.
records.en: It's true. Leader saved the day again.

records.jp: 「頑張ってくれたのはみんなだ」
records.en_original: But it was all of you who put in the hard work.
records.en: But it was all of you who put in the hard work.

records.jp: それは……リーダーが私たちを励まし、<CR>進むべき方向を指し示してくれたからだ
records.en_original: That's because you encouraged us, Leader, and showed us the way.
records.en: That's because you encouraged us, Leader, and showed us the way.

records.jp: 自分の頑張りを認めるのも大事だと、私は思う……。<CR>これからもよろしく頼む、リーダー
records.en_original: I believe it's important to acknowledge your own efforts, too... I'll be counting on you from now on as well, Leader.
records.en: I believe it's important to acknowledge your own efforts, too... I'll be counting on you from now on as well, Leader.

records.jp: 実は、３か月以内に３つの区画を奪還するよう、<CR>本部からの指示が来ている
records.en_original: As it stands, we've been given orders from HQ to take back three zones within the next three months.
records.en: As it stands, we've been given orders from HQ to take back three zones within the next three months.

records.jp: あと１区画の奪還に成功すれば、<CR>それで本部からのミッションは達成となる
records.en_original: If we can retake just one more, that will fulfill our mission from HQ.
records.en: If we can retake just one more, that will fulfill our mission from HQ.

records.jp: しかし、タイムリミットは僅かだ。<CR>どうにか間に合わせなければ……
records.en_original: But the timing is tight. We have to make it, somehow...
records.en: But the timing is tight. We have to make it, somehow...
